groups.color: Themed colours, named for what they colour. Each has a light and a dark value.
groups.spacing: Gaps and padding, named for the rhythm they set rather than a step on the scale.
groups.radius: Corner rounding for surfaces and controls.
groups.font-family: Typefaces for interface text and fixed-width data.
groups.font-size: Text sizes for body copy, controls, and surface titles.
groups.font-weight: Weights for body text, controls, and headings.
groups.letter-spacing: Optical tracking, tightening as type grows.
groups.line-height: Line heights for readable copy and compact labels.
groups.duration: Motion timing for feedback and overlay entrance. Collapsed to 1ms under reduced motion, except the spinner.
